findings.impact: Candidate provenance may name a different committed source; no evidence that the intentionally interrupted first formal attempt produced such a package.
findings.location: main: initial source-commit capture and final-source-state gate
findings.reason: main records git rev-parse HEAD before managed builds; its final guard asks only git status. A concurrent clean commit can pass that final guard while the emitted source-inventory and managed binaries belong wholly or partly to another commit. Unlike eng/task07_native.py, this entry point never compares final HEAD with its captured source identity.
findings.recommended_fix: Require final git rev-parse HEAD to equal the captured source before manifest emission, preserving the clean-state guard. Keep the execution workspace immutable for the entire build.
findings.title: A clean HEAD change during package construction can retain the old sourceCommit
findings.validation: Static control-flow proof; no source mutation or real package construction was attempted during this read-only review.
